mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy shift, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a weakening consumer demand cycle, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as corporate earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a high labor market tightness regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a monthly increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals robust economic growth that boosts corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past quarter indicates strengthening manufacturing activity, supporting corporate profit growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO rises, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 for two consecutive months, it signals a manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signal an accelerating inflationary environment with tightening monetary policy, depressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS increase, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In an early-cycle expansion regime (GDPC1 growth above 2.0% annually), a rise in retail sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer spending that boosts corporate revenues, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where GDPC1 > 2.0% annual growth and RSAFS rises, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.02.
